units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:13">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵃ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:7">Deut. IV, 7</cite>) <he>ק׳ בכל מיני קריבות</he> (God is) near in every way of nearness (at all times, in all places, in sympathy &c.).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 9a:5">Snh. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>נמצא … ק׳ וכ׳</he> if it appears that one of the witnesses is a near relative (of the defendant) or disqualified.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 9b:8">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם ק׳ אצל עצמו ואין וכ׳</he> every man is considered a relation to himself, and none can incriminate himself.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 10a:2">Ib. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם ק׳ … ואינו ק׳ אצל ממונו</he> a man cannot testify against himself, but he is not a relative to (disqualified to testify against) his property.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:4">Ib. III, 4</cite> <he>היה ק׳ ונתרחק</he> if a person was a relation (by marriage, so as to be disqualified), and became a stranger again.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39a:8">B. Mets. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>שבוי … מורידין ק׳ וכ׳</he> if a person has been carried off captive, they (the court) appoint a relative to manage his estate.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ מחמת ק׳</he> an indirect relative (e.g. one’s step-brother’s step-brother); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>קְרוֹבִים</he>, <he>קְרוֹבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 14b:5">Gitt. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ למלכות</he> connected with royalty, influential.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:4">Snh. III, 4</cite> <he>ואלו הן הק׳</he> the following are considered relatives (disqualified to act as judges or witnesses); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:7">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ נעשו רחוקים</he> near objects have become distant (my senses are dull from old age).—[Tanḥ.
B’shall. 18 ועברה קרובים; Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ top שהגיע לקרובין, v. קָרוּכִין.]—Fem. קְרוֹבָה. Y. Ber. l. c. ע״ז נראית ק׳ ואינה וכ׳ the idol is apparently near, but in fact distant.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> Haman reflected in his heart <he>אם אסתר … קְרוֹבָתִי</he> if Esther is a Jewess, she is my relative.
<cite ref="Megillah 14b:5">Meg. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>חולדה קְרוֹבַת וכ׳</he> Huldah was a relative of Jeremiah’s; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְרוֹבוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:4">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>נשא … מקְרוֹבוֹתָיו וכ׳</he> if a man marries one of his relatives, of him it is said ‘bone of my bones’ (<cite ref="Genesis 2:23">Gen. II, 23</cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>רחוקות נעשו ק׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> distant objects have become near (things that I could discern at a distance must be brought near me), near objects have become distant, v. supra; a. fr.
